pages.text: There were stepping stones in the stream in front of the watermill. Seven stones made a little path across the water.
"Today I want to cross by myself." Mumu stood by the stream. Dandelions were blooming in the field on the other side.
Dodo hopped over. "You start with the big stones. I know all about stepping stones!"
Dodo hopped onto the biggest stone. It wobbled from side to side.
Splash! Dodo fell into the stream. Water droplets flew everywhere.
Dodo floated on the water. "That stone... it was always a wobbly stone!"
Mumu pressed a foot down on the first stone to test it. The nearby stone was small, but it didn't move at all.
Mumu started with the nearest stone and crossed one hop at a time.
One last hop! Mumu landed softly on the grass on the other side.
Just then, Dodo swam over with a splash. "I took a shortcut!" They laughed together in the dandelion field.
